2226-2499-3634.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-3634.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2527-4076-4279-4549-6559.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-4076-4279-4549-6559.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1168-1479-2443-2841.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1168-1479-2443-2841.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2043-3480-7826.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Bag End Banquet that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
When the Bag End Banquet token enters, it triggers, creating three Food tokens.
Activate the Bag End Banquet token by tapping it, adding {C} for each Food you control.
Repeat
2043-3480-7826.notes: You can reduce the cost by up to {3} if you control additional Food(s) as you start the combo. You can also tap the original Bag End Banquet for mana after the Foods are created initially if you're able to do so.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it

193-2724-3908-3987.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat each turn.

933-1061-7679.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Conjurer's Closet.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

4802-5686--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

643-2511-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-2511-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

3330-3490-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1669-3234-3293-5147.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-5147.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-5147.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

1477-4375-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Extruder by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

276-4613-4968-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Angrath's Marauders.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2530-2577-6518-6720.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-6518-6720.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with MV=1 and Creates Creature Token(s) on Death

2178-5256-6542--110.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with mana value 0.
2178-5256-6542--110.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 0.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning the creature that creates creature token(s) on death from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Sidisi trigger.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the creature's trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2281-2511-3175.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

796-1762-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional Zombie creature.
796-1762-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Zombie creature, adding {R}.
Wilhelt triggers, creating a 3/3 Zombie token with no abilities due to Poppet Factory.
Repeat.

122-1496-1734-2292.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Fiend Hunter's toughness.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Phyrexian Delver until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Phyrexian Delver from exile to the battlefield.
Phyrexian Delver enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Verdant Sun's Avatar.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life equal to Phyrexian Delver's toughness.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose three life.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Viscera Seer abilities, causing you to scry 1 infinite times.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2034-2820-4668-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Heliod, adding {C}{C}.
When Heliod dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Angelic Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Angelic Renewal trigger, causing you to sacrifice it and return Heliod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Heliod enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angelic Renewal from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Cast Angelic Renewal by paying {1}{W}.
Repeat.

251-1349-4050.notablePrerequisites: Denry Klin and another nontoken creature you control each have a coin counter on them.
251-1349-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrifiing another nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Athreos' third ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Denry Klin triggers, putting a coin counter on it.
Repeat.

4490-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the card's mana value.
Shalai and Hallar triggers if counters were placed this way, as well as Phyrexian Devourer if its power is seven or greater.
Resolve the Shalai and Hallar trigger, dealling one damage to an opponent for each counter placed this way.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2105-3337-3809.easyPrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki and Goldspan Dragon do not have summoning sickness.
2105-3337-3809.notablePrerequisites: Goldspan Dragon cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2105-3337-3809.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Goldspan Dragon and Combat Celebrant token as an attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebbrant as it attacks.
The token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Goldspan Dragon deals combat damage to a player, causing you to create a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

2104-2674-3554.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Personal Tutor and Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Cast Personal Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Seasons Past from your library.
Repeat.
